arrays_verdict: Arrays lose on every count measured here. (1) The 0.8 mm-pitch CTS 742C043/742C083 match the TSOP pitch but their lands are 2.6/2.7 mm deep (measured on R1/R34): 3.0/3.1 mm needed vs 1.47 mm south (toe to the C135-C41 0201 decoupling row) and 0.47 mm north (toe to R80-R83). (2) The 0201-element arrays fit the south depth (1.31 mm needed, assumed lands) but their 0.20/0.25 mm element gaps are < 0.28 mm, so only the two END elements can return on Bottom: a 4-element array serves 2 nets, and a 2-element array only a DQ pair whose BOTH flank gaps are usable. (3) Of the six 0.8 mm DQ pairs only D3/D4 has both flank gaps usable (D1/D2: 5|6 is the FT-VPHY neck; D5/D6: 11|12 is the FT-VCORE neck; north pairs: blocked as listed) and an array on D3/D4 would cover gap 7|8, which the south pocket needs for TMS (7 gaps for 7 users). (4) Discrete 0201s use the board's existing R0201 footprint and process, keep >= 0.3 mm between Rs (vs ~0.1 mm element spacing), and close all eight south nets with 0 rule violations.
